summary:
No decision was reached. 2 open questions, and no one took an explicit position on an option.

STATUS: No decision was reached. 2 open questions, and no one took an explicit position on an option.

## The main point

The discussion centers on two related but distinct activities involving Alpha Evolve and a broader AI strategy review. Jessica Wakefield drafted a two-page document covering Alpha Evolve's progress and the path forward, and asked Guruprasad Parab to confirm their team's accomplishments are accurately represented, and asked Sangeetha Somayajula to confirm she is comfortable with the stated timelines — neither has responded with confirmation. Monisha Somji drew a line between a Wednesday Alpha Evolve progress update and a broader always-on learning AI strategy assessment involving Ashok, Maddy, Naga, Vikram, and others, covering Alpha Evolve, Auto-Research, and System 1, with an end-of-October target for bringing recommendations to RL. Sommer Hoffman stated that the Corporate Services classification prevents the Friday presentation and has proposed a separate RL meeting on October 14th at 10:30 AM ET, asking everyone to adjust their schedules. Monisha asked Sommer, Jessica, Maddy, and Vikram for their perspectives on keeping the two tracks separate ahead of Wednesday; none of them have replied.

## Open questions

- How to optimize self-improving agents/systems (raised by an unidentified sender)
- When and where to present Alpha Evolve progress to Ratnakar (raised by Jessica Wakefield)

## Where people stand

- Present to Ratnakar this Friday: no explicit position recorded
- Present to RL in a separate meeting: no explicit position recorded
- RL meeting on October 14th at 10:30 AM ET: no explicit position recorded

Monisha Somji said: "For Wednesday, let's focus on Alpha Evolve's progress, key learnings, and potential, while keeping the broader strategic assessment separate."

## What is blocking progress

- Corporate Services classification prevents the Friday presentation with RL (Sommer Hoffman)
- Confirmations from Guruprasad Parab and Sangeetha Somayajula on the two-pager are still outstanding (Jessica Wakefield)
- Perspectives from Sommer, Jessica, Maddy, and Vikram on separating the two tracks have not been received ahead of Wednesday (Monisha Somji)

## Next steps

- Jessica Wakefield asked Guruprasad Parab to confirm that the two-pager accurately represents their team's accomplishments from last week; no reply recorded.
- Jessica Wakefield asked Sangeetha Somayajula to confirm she is comfortable with the definitive timelines; no reply recorded.
- Sommer Hoffman will work with Joanna to find exclusive time with RL.
- Sommer Hoffman is sending a calendar invite to all for October 14th at 10:30 AM ET.

## Awaiting a reply

- Jessica Wakefield asked Guruprasad Parab to confirm the two-pager accurately reflects their team's accomplishments; no reply recorded.
- Jessica Wakefield asked Sangeetha Somayajula to confirm comfort with the definitive timelines; no reply recorded.
- Monisha Somji asked Sommer Hoffman, Jessica Wakefield, Maddy Vasantham, and Vikram Bandugula for their perspectives on the proposed Wednesday focus; no reply recorded from any of them.

## Things people asserted that others may want to check

- An unidentified sender said self-improving agents and systems by nature require deep thinking and proposed experimentation.
- Jessica Wakefield said Ratnakar wants to stay closely aligned with Alpha Evolve progress to date.
- Jessica Wakefield said the two-pager covers accomplishments on page one and the path forward for evaluating the product on page two.
